source: Derived at build time by tools/build-data.js from the published receipt ledgers in /data/. Counts only; no grading.
note: An INVENTORY, not a scoreboard. There is no honest Brier across domains, so this file counts what has been registered and settled and never scores it. The ledgers OVERLAP: receipts.json and the nfelo half of model-receipts.json are the same forecasts, as are 538-classic.json and its half. aggregate is therefore computed from aggregate.counted_from alone; aggregate.naive_sum is what summing the registered column would wrongly give, published so it can be named and corrected rather than quietly reproduced.

ledgers.name: NFL model receipts
ledgers.what: Append-only prospective forecasts, one row per model per game. This is the superset the others are views of.

ledgers.name: NFL pre-registered calls
ledgers.what: The locked, SHA-256 hashed nfelo set. The same forecasts as the nfelo half of the ledger above, fixed in place so they cannot be edited after a result.

ledgers.name: 538 Classic beliefs
ledgers.what: A deliberately simple Elo benchmark with no QB, injury, weather or market adjustment.

ledgers.name: DDPR NFL ensemble
ledgers.what: Both pre-registered ensemble aggregations, one row per game carrying two probabilities: 272 games, 544 receipts in the superset. A FUNCTION of the nfelo and 538 Classic rows, not independent evidence. The linear average is registered for comparison and is never displayed.

ledgers.name: CFB model receipts
ledgers.what: The college-football contract. Empty by design: no CFB forecast has been frozen before a kickoff yet.

tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.
